owner_rationale: The upstream datasets were already publicly accessible.
The release README cites each upstream dataset and records the upstream license or terms that apply to that payload.
The repository publishes the exact Parquet files consumed by the training and evaluation workflows; publication does not introduce another format conversion.
The complete Math-7 and Code-4 workflow requires the full collection rather than the five-payload subset.

owner_statement_evidence.statement_verbatim: 我觉得这几个都可以公开。因为数据集不是我们自己构建的，我们只是把它改了一下格式，数据本来就是公开的，最多是有git历史在里面。

attribution_and_license_policy.policy: Cite every upstream dataset and preserve its declared license or terms instead of assigning one blanket license to this multi-source collection.

format_policy.policy: Upload the exact training and evaluation Parquet bytes used by the project.

history_policy.mutation: append one compare-and-swap commit to the reviewed private main HEAD; do not delete, recreate, squash, or rewrite the repository

acknowledgements: The repository owner approves public release of the complete 13-payload collection.
The README and publication inventory must preserve per-source attribution and upstream license or terms.
The publication bundle must preserve the exact payload SHA-256 values used by the project.
Existing repository history must be preserved.
release_requirements: Upload and verify the approved bundle while the repository remains private.
Use the reviewed private HEAD as create_commit parent_commit and preserve the complete existing history.
Do not call delete_repo, create_repo, super_squash_history, or any force-history operation.
Verify private=false and gated=false after the visibility transition.
Download the immutable public revision without credentials into an empty directory and pass the bundled validator.
Record the immutable public revision and verification receipt in the code repository.
